### Added

- (agent-platform) [Harness column and filter, Harness limits, reported cost in usage](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2858) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Where agents use more than one Harness, the Agents list has a `Harness` column and an `All Harnesses` filter. An agent's Status card and the create wizard show its Claude Code Harness's limits, and the Usage tab shows `Reported cost` beside `Est. cost`.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Link the first-agent invitation to the create form](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2878) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On an empty Agents or Sessions tab, `Create your first agent` is a link to the create form, so it opens the form however it is clicked, also in a new tab.
- (gs) [Keep pre-release bounds and v-tags on the Edit button](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2854) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On a deployment's page, `Edit` keeps a range such as `>=1.0.0-0 <3.0.0` as a custom range, so an unchanged edit no longer stops upgrades to `3.0.0-rc.1`. A current version such as `v1.2.4` pre-fills the same mode as `1.2.4`.
- (plans) [Show one scrollbar in full-screen reading](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2873) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Reading a plan in full screen shows a single scrollbar, the document's own, instead of three side by side.
- (scaffolder) [Declined re-login at Create reports the expired sign-in](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2879) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — When the portal sign-in has expired and the person declines to sign in again at `Create`, a template's review step shows `Your sign-in expired` with the entries kept, instead of `Couldn't start the template`.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2861) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared team-label and project-board workflows.
- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2875) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared README link check workflow.
- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2881) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared CircleCI workflows.
- (deps) [Update dependency @lezer/highlight to v1.2.4](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2853) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update yarn monorepo](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2855) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (several plugins) [Reference the MCP servers by their unprefixed names](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2872) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Comments, changesets and test fixtures name the fleet MCP servers for marge and pro by their new names, without an installation prefix. Nothing changes in the portal.
